static_traits.name: Liu Jianmin
static_traits.family_status: Divorced,育有一儿一Female;Work日照顾祖母.
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友与家人可交流,但尚not yet与他们讨论与约会相关的not安全感.
static_traits.medical_history: without明显躯体疾病;without既往心理咨询史;without类似问题既往史.
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性Good,语速平稳,配合度高;情绪略显紧张与羞涩,带有Self-doubt.

basic_info.main_problem: 我担心潜在伴侣not会愿意和我约会,因为我Has two children,这种信念正在导致我在约会中的not安全感与怀疑,并使我在追求新的关系时犹豫Withdrawal.
basic_info.core_demands: Came to seek counseling because I realized these beliefs hinder me from building new connections; I hope to test and challenge these thoughts and obtain more accurate and balanced views, so as to date with a more confident posture.
growth_experiences: 经历Divorce后重新进入约会场景,随之出现并逐渐加剧了'因为Has two children而会被潜在伴侣拒绝'的not安全感与怀疑.
承担较多家庭照料责任:抚养一儿一Female,并在Work日照顾祖母,需要在个人生活与家庭责任之间not断权衡与平衡.
曾有几次约会在提到孩子后对方态度转冷,这些经历Reinforcement了其'有孩子等于Being rejected'的担忧与信念.

core_beliefs: 我not够被需要/not值得被选择(作为伴侣)
Having children equals burden and will make others reject me

special_situations.event: 想到要向潜在伴侣说明自己Has two children,或谈到与家庭相关的话题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我透露自己Has two children,对方就会认为我是'负担',从而拒绝我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在关系初期保持防御与疏离,减少自我暴露,干脆not去追求心仪对象
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会因此拒绝我/not人会想和我约会

special_situations.event: Recalling several dating experiences where the other person's attitude turned cold after mentioning children
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 几次not顺利就证明大多数人都not愿与有孩子的人约会
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Treats such experiences as a general rule, lowering expectations in advance and avoiding further contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 果然大家都会这样,我会Being rejected

special_situations.event: Others express appreciation for their care of the grandmother and family responsibilities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正向反馈只是偶然,not能代表真实情况
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 淡化或negate积极证据,继续以负面经验为主做判断

special_situations.event: Before dating, presets others' views based on 'society's prejudice against people with children'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Society's general view necessarily applies to every person I encounter
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses presumed others' viewpoints to guide action, contracting in advance to avoid embarrassment or rejection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will surely think I have too much baggage

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and build an intimate, stable relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fears being seen as a 'burden', being rejected, and feeling ashamed
defense_goal: 通过保持距离与Withdrawal来避免Being rejected
Uses the 'social prejudice' explanation to reduce personal vulnerability
Reducing self-disclosure to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: 带着'负担'的潜在被拒者,not会被选择的Father

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被问及为何not主动追求或在约会前谈及孩子/家庭责任时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the other party will, as before, view them as a 'burden' and ultimately reject them (transference: projecting past rejection experiences onto the current relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, presetting the other party's negative stance in advance, reducing self-disclosure, and quickly turning to objective statements to avoid going deep into feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out positive evidence or encourages reality testing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把关系受挫归因为'社会偏见'的必然性,从而认为个人without力改变
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use宏观与客观的论述(如'社会期待/偏见'),弱化个人渴望与情绪体验,以平稳语气维持自洽.

manifestations: Divorce后重返约会,因担忧被拒而Withdrawal
not愿与朋友/家人讨论相关not安感
Feels isolated and embarrassed before and after dates
Balances personal life and dating between raising two children and caring for grandmother on weekdays
Responsibility brings trade-offs and a sense of constraint in choices
outcomes: Reducing outings and dates and postponing new relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: More guarded and less adventurous in dating

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 想要接近与建立联系的冲动被压回自身,转为Withdrawal与not行动
在感到紧张时选择not去追求感兴趣的人

exception_events.target_problem: 在需要向潜在伴侣提及孩子或家庭责任的约会情境中,来访者通常会Anticipation被拒并变得Withdrawal,结果减少互动或中断追求.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有一次,对方认为其在Work日照顾祖母,承担家庭责任'很温暖',并称赞其对家庭的投入,这与以往被冷淡的经历not同,带来了更积极的互动体验.
exception_events.reason: Clue: the other party holds values more recognizing family responsibility; the client truthfully presents their care and sense of responsibility, enabling the other party to see their strengths and give positive feedback.

positive_force: Has a sense of responsibility toward family and has received others' recognition (cared for grandmother, raised two children)
Willing to seek help and do reality testing and behavioral attempts
Has had dating experiences that started smoothly, with a real basis for building connections
Has some capacity for positive self-talk
Has a potential support network of friends and family
negative_force: Mind reading and overgeneralization, amplifying negative experiences
negate积极证据与心理过滤,忽视正向线索
羞耻与对被拒的Fear引发的回避和Withdrawal
将困境归因为'社会偏见',形成Rationalization与外控感

target_behavior.behavior: 在约会/与潜在伴侣接触时的Withdrawal与回避
antecedent: 想到要透露自己Has two children
Assuming society's bias against people with children
Recalls past experiences where the other turned cold after children were mentioned
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizes the notion that 'having children = burden', worrying about being rejected because of it and experiencing shame and damaged self-worth
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential rejection and shame, gaining short-term safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: 主动性与社交机会减少,关系启动与发展受阻,进一步加重Loneliness与Self-doubt
